body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Quiet ghost watcher; notices a supported danger without melodrama. Slightly eerie, still useful and intelligible. Voice direction: High androgynous voice with a light Australian accent and clear floaty breath edge. Quiet suspended phrasing, subtly spectral but conversational. No added reverb, echo or whispered inaudibility. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: The reply was waiting. Move the defender, and the piece is left alone. The other side can take it. Look at that connection.
